title: Proposal
description: A proposed action awaiting confirmation (docs/design/m0/04 "Proposals and confirmation"), recorded when the action's confirmation policy is not none. binding_digest is the JCS digest of {action, change_class, project, object, expected_state, scope, proposed_by} and, when the change has one, its grantee; a confirmation binds exactly that digest. scope is the command's input; object, project, grantee, change_class and expected_state are derived server side. open is the pending state. At apply, authority revalidates the expected state, the proposer's grant, the policy and the confirmer, and otherwise invalidates the proposal; invalidated_reason is the registered reason, null in every other state.

grantee.description: The actor a grant change is for, as derived; null when the change creates or extends no grant.

grant.description: The grant the proposal was decided under (null for an operator's); at apply it must still be the one that covers it, never a substitute.
